description: This source file defines the ImmutableFeature class, which is an immutable implementation of the Feature interface within the Ditto model for 'things'. It includes methods for creating and manipulating features, such as setting properties and definitions, and converting to JSON.

classes.name: ImmutableFeature
classes.description: An immutable, fully encapsulated implementation of the Feature interface, representing a feature with an ID, optional definition, and properties. Provides methods for creation, comparison, JSON serialization, and property manipulation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ImmutableFeature with a specified ID, optional definition, and optional properties. Validates the ID against control character and slash restrictions.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with the specified definition set.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with the definition removed.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the properties of the feature.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with the specified properties.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Returns a new Feature with properties removed.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value at the specified JSON pointer path.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property at the specified JSON pointer path with the given value, returning a new Feature.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property at the specified JSON pointer path, returning a new Feature.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature's definition.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature to a JsonObject considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on featureId, definition, and properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on featureId, definition, and properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ImmutableFeature.
